clark.name: Tiny
clark.bio: Meet Tiny! Tiny came to CCHS as an owner surrender, previously set to be a barn cat however a little bit of wobble in her step had the owner bringing her over to us. This itty-bitty bashful gal is about 11 months old and weighs roughly 4.4lbs currently. Tiny is a sweet gal who is just a little unsure of things! She wasn't given a lot of socialization so she is the teeniest timid, but one thing for certain is that she looooves affection! She does not always know how to ask for it, but with a gentle touch and a little patience, she's very easy to win over. Tiny currently resides in our Kitty City with a number of other feline friends. Less

clark.name: Luke
clark.bio: Luke may be the lone boy name surrounded by a litter of Gilmore Girls, but this Rat Terrier/Border Collie mix is every bit as ready for his starring role! Luke is a sweet and smart puppy who is looking for a family ready to make him part of their everyday lives. He’s got plenty of growing, learning, playing, and exploring ahead of him, and his future family will get to be there for all of it. He’ll need patience and guidance as he learns how to navigate the world, but that’s part of the fun of bringing home a puppy. Luke is ready for his forever family—and hopefully a lifetime of happy endings. Less

clark.name: Little Miss
clark.bio: Little Miss is a beautiful 1-year-old tabby who has already accomplished quite a lot in her short life—she raised a whole litter of kittens! Now her babies are grown, ready to head off to homes of their own, and this sweet mama is officially off duty. After spending so much time taking care of her little ones, Little Miss is finally ready for someone to take care of her. She deserves a home where she can relax, soak up all the love and attention, and enjoy being someone’s baby for a change. Her mama duties are done. Her kittens are ready. Now it’s Little Miss’s turn for her happily ever after. Less

clark.name: Logan
clark.bio: Logan is one of the boys of our Gilmore Girl litter, and this Rat Terrier/Border Collie mix is ready to meet his future family! Logan is a sweet, smart puppy with a whole lifetime ahead of him. His new family will get to experience all the fun that comes with watching a puppy grow—from those goofy puppy moments to the satisfaction of seeing him learn something new. He’ll need a family who is ready to put in the time and patience that raising a puppy requires, but Logan will have so much potential to become an incredible lifelong companion. His forever story is just getting started. Could you be part of it? Less

clark.name: Darla
clark.bio: If you're looking for a dog with brains, loyalty, and a heart that's worth earning, meet Darla! Like many Heelers, Darla is incredibly intelligent and loves having a job to do. She's observant, eager to learn, and forms deep bonds with the people she trusts. Once you're part of her circle, you'll discover what a sweet, devoted companion she truly is. Darla can be a little shy when meeting new people and may take some time to warm up—especially around some men—but patience and kindness go a long way. She'll do best with someone who understands that trust isn't rushed, and that watching a timid dog blossom is one of life's greatest rewards. Darla is looking for an adult-only home, as she's not comfortable living with children. In the right environment, with people who respect her boundaries and appreciate her brilliant mind, she's sure to become an incredibly loyal best friend. If you're ready to invest a little time and a lot of love, Darla is ready to show you just how special she is. Darla's adoption fee is sponsored by an anonymous donor! Less

clark.name: Biggie
clark.bio: Biggie may have arrived as a stray, but hes quickly showing that underneath his unsure first impressions is a big-hearted dog just waiting for the right person to help him feel safe. At around 4 years old, Biggie is past the puppy chaos but still has plenty of life, love, and personality to share. He can be a little skittish when meeting new people or experiencing new environments, but give him a bit of time and patience and youll see the transformation-soft eyes, relaxed body language, and a whole lot of affection. Once Biggie trusts you, he leans in hard for love. He enjoys gentle attention, reassurance, and simply being near his person. Hes the kind of dog who bonds deeply and becomes incredibly loyal once he knows hes safe. Biggie will do best in a calm, patient home that understands he may need a little time to decompress and adjust. In return, he offers a big personality, a big heart, and a whole lot of love just waiting to come out. If youre looking for a diamond-in-the-ruff who just needs someone to believe in him, Biggie might be your guy. Less

Peeta is looking for a family that will help him learn all about house training, basic manners, and how wonderful life as a beloved family member can be.

clark.name: Alfie
clark.bio: Meet Alfie! This handsome young guy came to us as a stray, and while his journey hasn't been the easiest, he's proving just how resilient he is. Alfie recently underwent hip surgery and is recovering well, but he'll need a family that understands his ongoing needs and is willing to give him the time and support he deserves. Don't let that fool you into thinking he's fragile, though—Alfie's favorite thing in the world is people! He loves attention, affection, and being the center of your universe. Whether he's soaking up pets, following you around, or curling up nearby, Alfie is happiest when he's with his humans. If you're looking for a loving companion and have room in your heart for a special cat who's ready for a fresh start, Alfie may be the perfect match. Less

clark.name: Bowie
clark.bio: Bowie is one seriously entertaining puppy! This adorable terrier mix is energetic, playful, curious, and just a little bit crazy—in the absolute best puppy way. Bowie loves being part of the action and has never met a game he didn’t want to join. He’s got plenty of puppy zoomies, plenty of goofy antics, and plenty of opinions to share. His terrier personality shines through in his confidence, enthusiasm, and determination to investigate everything around him. Bowie is looking for a family ready to embrace puppyhood in all its chaotic glory and help him grow into the wonderful dog he’s meant to be. With training, exercise, and lots of love, this goofy guy is going to make someone a fantastic companion! Less

clark.name: Chelsea
clark.bio: Chelsea is a teeny-tiny Beagle/Jack Russell mix with an awful lot of sweetness packed into one little puppy! She came to us with her siblings Barbie, Skipper, and Stacey, and now this adorable girl is ready to find her own special family. Chelsea is looking forward to discovering what it means to have people of her very own to love and care for her. Puppyhood is full of exciting firsts, and Chelsea is ready for all of them! She’ll need a family who is prepared for the work that comes with raising a puppy, but also ready to enjoy the ridiculous amount of cuteness that comes along with it. clark.name: Ruby
clark.bio: Ruby is a gorgeous Husky mix whose piercing blue eyes are guaranteed to catch your attention! Of course, those beautiful Husky looks come with a personality to match. Ruby has plenty of the classic Husky traits that make this breed so beloved—and sometimes keep their families on their toes! She’s looking for a home that understands Huskies and appreciates their intelligence, independence, energy, and unique personalities. Ruby isn’t looking for someone who simply wants a pretty dog. She needs a family who will enjoy her for everything that makes her a Husky. If you’ve always had a soft spot for those blue-eyed Husky faces, Ruby would love to meet you. Less

clark.bio: Nacho is a Chihuahua Pomeranian dog.

clark.name: Miley
clark.bio: Miley’s story didn’t start the way we wish it had. She came to us as a stray with an injured eye, and we can only imagine how confusing and frightening that must have been for her. Miley is a Hound mix with a sweet soul and an expression that seems to carry a little bit of sadness with it. But she is here now, she is safe, and she has the opportunity to start over. What Miley needs most is someone who will see past her sad eyes and recognize the sweet girl underneath. Someone who will give her time to settle in, show her what being loved feels like, and give her the happy ending every stray deserves. Miley is ready for a home where she doesn’t have to wonder where she belongs anymore. Please note the "Start Your Inquiry" button to the right above is not submitting your application. clark.name: Reyn
clark.bio: Reyns' story didn't begin the way every dog deserves. She, along with Connie and Nana, were abandoned and left behind in a basement, relying only on each other until help finally arrived. Despite everything, Reyn hasn't let her past steal her future. She's a sweet, gentle soul whos ready to discover what it means to be someones beloved companion. Whether its following her nose on a leisurely walk, soaking up attention, or simply enjoying the comfort of a warm bed, Reyn is ready for the life shes always deserved. Shes looking for a family that understands trust takes time, but knows the reward of watching a dogs confidence bloom is worth every moment. Reyn has survived the hardest chapter of her life—now shes ready for the happiest one. Less

clark.name: Rita
clark.bio: Rita is a 4-year-old Domestic Shorthair who came in with Tom Tom and is still learning that the world and people can be safe. She is not very socialized yet and tends to be shy in new situations, preferring to observe from a distance rather than jump right into interaction. Because of her background, Rita will need a patient home that allows her to adjust at her own pace without pressure. She may take time to warm up, but with consistency and a calm environment, she has the potential to build confidence and slowly learn trust. Rita would do best in a quiet home where routines are predictable, and she can feel secure. She's not the type to demand attention, but she deserves a space where she can finally relax and just be herself. For someone willing to give her time and understanding, Rita can blossom into a quiet, steady companion. Less

clark.name: Teller
clark.bio: Meet Teller, a brilliant young dog with a thoughtful heart and a story that's led her right back to us through no fault of her own. At just 10 months old, this Rat Terrier and Cattle Dog mix already shows off her impressive intelligence and communication skills. She even knows how to use a button to let you know when she needs to go potty! Teller was originally adopted but sadly returned due to changes in her owner's circumstances. Because of that, she can be a little slow to trust when meeting new people and adjusting to new environments. She likes to take her time observing the world and figuring out who feels safe. But once Teller decides you're her person, she truly shines. She becomes a deeply loyal, affectionate, and devoted companion who sticks close and bonds hard. Her smart, attentive nature makes her an incredible partner for someone willing to give her patience and consistency. With her mix of brains, sensitivity, and heart, Teller will thrive in a calm, understanding home that lets her open up at her own pace. In return, she offers one of the most rewarding bonds you can ask for. Teller isn't just looking for a home, but is looking for someone to trust completely. Less

clark.name: Ranger
clark.bio: Ranger is a handsome 25-week-old tri-color Aussie/Collie mix weighing about 28 pounds. This sweet boy was adopted once before, but unfortunately, he was brought back to us after his family realized he was a little more puppy than they were prepared for. And yep—Ranger is definitely still a puppy! He’s got growing to do, things to learn, and plenty of puppy energy to burn. But underneath all of that puppy enthusiasm is an incredibly sweet and lovable boy who just wants to be part of the family. Ranger is affectionate, adorable, and ready for a fresh start with someone who understands that puppies take a little patience, consistency, and training. Give him that, and we think you’ll have one pretty amazing best friend on your hands. Come meet Ranger and see if this handsome little guy is the missing piece in your family! Less

clark.name: Piper
clark.bio: Piper is a big, goofy Pit mix with an even bigger heart! Piper came to us after her owner went away to college and was no longer able to keep her. It’s never easy when a dog loses the person they thought would be theirs forever, but Piper is ready to put that chapter behind her and find a family who is ready to make a lifelong commitment. This girl is lovable, silly, and full of personality. She’s the kind of dog who can bring a little laughter into your day just by being herself. Piper doesn’t need perfection—she just needs someone who will love her, include her, and make sure she knows she’s home for good this time. If big dogs with big hearts are your thing, Piper is waiting to meet you! Please note the "Start Your Inquiry" button to the right above is not submitting your application. clark.name: Foxy
clark.bio: This beautiful 6-year-old American Eskimo weighs 19 pounds and is ready to find someone she can trust. Foxy came to us from an Amish rescue and, understandably, she can be a little nervous when meeting new people. She may need some time and patience to feel comfortable, but once she knows she’s safe, she’s ready to discover what it means to be loved. Foxy is looking for a patient person who will let her take things at her own pace and show her that the world can be a wonderful place. With the right person by her side, this little diva has the potential to truly blossom. Foxy is ready for her chance to trade nervous beginnings for a life filled with love, comfort, and plenty of pampering! Less

clark.name: Lita
clark.bio: This beautiful 5-year-old tricolored Lab mix is ready to find her forever family. Lita weighs 83 pounds and is, admittedly, carrying a little extra love around with her! She would benefit from a family committed to helping her get back to a healthier weight through appropriate exercise, activity, and plenty of love. One thing Lita absolutely loves? Being outside! Whether she’s enjoying some fresh air, exploring the yard, or simply soaking up the sunshine, she’s happiest when she gets to spend time outdoors. If you’re looking for a sweet Lab mix who is ready to enjoy life by your side, come meet Lita! Less

clark.name: Janet
clark.bio: Meet Janet! This adorable tabby girl is ready to find her forever family. Janet is one of our sweet Jackson kittens, and she’s looking for a home where she can grow, play, explore, and be loved. She may be little, but she has a whole lot of love ahead of her to give! Come meet Janet and see if this pretty girl is the missing piece to your family.

clark.name: Peanut
clark.bio: Peanut may be little, but this sweet kitten has a big place in our hearts! Peanut is part of a wonderful kitten crew with siblings Butter, Butterscotch, Chip, Spice, and Sugar. Peanut is ready to start the next chapter of life with a family who will provide love, patience, and plenty of opportunities to play. Whether it’s chasing toys, exploring new places, or curling up for a cozy nap, Peanut is ready for it all. Could Peanut be the missing piece your family has been looking for? Less

clark.bio: Coletta is a Labrador Retriever dog.

clark.name: Meenie
clark.bio: Say hello to Meenie! This sweet kitten is ready to bring some fun, purrs, and personality into a lucky family’s life. Meenie is part of a lovable sibling group with Bo, Eenie, Minie, and Mo. Meenie enjoys the simple pleasures of kitten life — playtime, exploring, and discovering new things every day. With love, guidance, and plenty of attention, Meenie will grow into a fantastic feline friend. Meenie is ready to start the next chapter of their story. Could it be with you?

clark.name: Nana
clark.bio: For too long, Nana's world was limited to four basement walls. Abandoned alongside her companions, Reyn and Connie, she waited patiently for someone to find her—and thankfully, that day finally came. Now Nana is getting the chance to experience all the things every dog should know: kindness, security, soft beds, full bellies, and people who wont leave her behind. She's a beautiful coonhound with so much love still waiting to give to the right family. Nana doesn't need a perfect home—she just needs one that's patient, understanding, and ready to show her that forever really can mean forever. If you're looking for a loyal friend whose best days are still ahead, Nana is waiting to meet you! Less

clark.name: Lorelai
clark.bio: Lorelei is one of our adorable Gilmore Girl litter puppies! This sweet Rat Terrier/Border Collie mix is ready to find someone who will love her through every stage of life. Lorelei is smart and lovable and is just beginning to figure out what the big wide world is all about. Her future family will get to help her learn everything from the important basics to all the little things that make a dog a wonderful member of the family. She’s looking for someone who is ready for puppyhood—the training, the adventures, the occasional mischief, and all those precious cuddles. Lorelei is ready to write her next chapter.

clark.name: Hendrix
clark.bio: Hendrix is a little terrier mix with a rockstar personality! He is energetic, playful, goofy, and always ready to turn the volume up to eleven. Like any good terrier puppy, Hendrix is curious about EVERYTHING. He loves to play, explore, wrestle, zoom around, and generally make sure there is never a dull moment. He’s got a fun-loving personality and plenty of puppy energy that will need an outlet through play, exercise, training, and enrichment. If your idea of the perfect puppy includes a little bit of chaos, a lot of laughs, and an adorable face you can’t resist, Hendrix could be your next best friend! Less

clark.name: Lennon
clark.bio: Lennon is a goofy little terrier mix who is always ready for fun! He’s energetic, playful, curious, and has absolutely no shortage of puppy personality. Lennon loves to run, wrestle, explore, and join in on whatever his siblings are doing. He has the classic terrier enthusiasm and can be delightfully loud when he feels like sharing his thoughts with the world. He’s still young and learning, so his future family should be prepared for plenty of puppy energy, training, chewing, zoomies, and general silliness. With the right family, Lennon will have everything he needs to grow into a happy, well-rounded companion—and he’s sure to provide plenty of laughs along the way!

clark.name: Ozzy
clark.bio: Ozzy is a little wild man with a serious talent for making people laugh! This terrier mix is energetic, goofy, loud, playful, and always ready for his next adventure. Ozzy has that unmistakable terrier personality. He’s curious, busy, enthusiastic, and absolutely loves to play. Whether he’s wrestling with a sibling, zooming around, investigating something suspicious, or making his opinions known, Ozzy knows how to keep things interesting! He’s looking for a family who will give him plenty of exercise, enrichment, training, and love while he grows into his big personality. If you want a puppy who will keep you laughing and never let life get boring, Ozzy is your guy! Less

clark.name: Butterscotch
clark.bio: Sweet as his name suggests, Butterscotch is a charming kitten looking for a forever home! He is part of a wonderful litter with siblings Butter, Chip, Peanut, Spice, and Sugar. Butterscotch is playful, curious, and full of kitten personality. He’s ready for a home where he can chase toys, discover new adventures, and enjoy plenty of love and attention. Bring home Butterscotch and add a little extra sweetness to your family! Less

clark.name: Tom Tom
clark.bio: Tom Tom is a gentle 10-year-old Domestic Shorthair who is looking for a calm, comfortable place to spend his golden years. He has some neuro and mobility concerns noted, and would do best in a home that understands he may move a little differently and appreciate life at a slower pace. He is on the shy and timid side, and hasn't had a lot of socialization, so new environments and people can feel overwhelming for him at first. With patience and consistency, he should start to settle in and show his quiet, soft personality underneath. Tom Tom isn't the kind of cat who will demand attention, but he does want comfort, safety, and a predictable routine. He would thrive in a low-traffic home where he can relax, observe, and simply be cared for without pressure. If you're looking for a low-key companion who just needs a soft landing and a kind place to land for his later years, Tom Tom may be the perfect gentle soul. Less

clark.name: Bailey
clark.bio: This handsome 8-year-old curly-coated Miniature Poodle weighs just 9 pounds, but he has a whole lot of life left to enjoy! Bailey came to us as part of an Amish rescue, and now he’s ready to discover all the good things life has to offer. At 8 years old, Bailey is ready to spend his golden years being spoiled, pampered, and treated like the little prince he is. We think Bailey deserves a life of comfort and luxury—with soft beds, cozy laps, tasty treats, and someone who will remind him every day just how loved he is. If you’re looking for a tiny companion to spoil rotten, Bailey may be your perfect match! Less

adams.name: Pika
adams.bio: My adoption fee is only $25 for the month of July! The first thing people notice about Pika is that she is a senior cat, but once you meet her and she has warmed up to you, you'd never believe it. This sweet girl has had a rough life so far and she wears her fear in her gaze. She takes a fair bit to warm up, but she is learning what love is every day. She still gets scared and is easily overstimulated, so she would need someone patient and calm who will not overwhelm her as she continues to open up. She enjoys gentle belly rubs, pets on her head and shoulders (NOT her rump!), and being spoken to with soothing words of encouragement. She will give affectionate headbutts and even enjoys the rare kiss on her noggin. She is known to lash out when startled, overwhelmed, or overstimulated, but is otherwise a very gentle sweetheart. She just needs someone who will respect her peace as she overcomes years of trauma and learns how to trust. Is that somebody you? Less

fetch.name: Gretzky
fetch.bio: Ello again...In case you forgot, I'm Gretzky. I've been in foster care for a long time now and I've really got a good schedule down. I'll tell you about it if you want....First I wake up and am excited to go potty outside. It's one of my favorite times and I may bark or nip your butt with excitement. Don't worry, I'm not /that/ excited. I just really have to pee. Then I come inside and lay on my beddy. It's my favorite spot. Unfortunately, I'm what my foster calls 'a babe magnet.' This means my canine and feline roommates will come to snuggle in my beddy with me, even in very warm temperatures. I don't understand it either. So we spend the next several hours rotating beddies until lunch, when we go back outside. Much sleeping is had. And snacks. Then the garage door opens and my room mates and I loose our collective minds because foster M'mam is home! I love her. And it means we get to do the best thing ever: walkies. I love pooping when I'm on a leash. I love walking. I don't need to smell anything, I don't care. I just like to walk. Especially in the woods! Sometimes we will see people on our walk. It makes me very nervous. Sometimes they will ask to pet me. I tell them 'No Thank You' by desperately trying to get away from them. Then I am edgy the rest of the walk. What if they secretly pop out of a bush to pet me?? Sometimes my foster M'mam will lock me in the bathroom and pet me. I've gotten used to this strange habit, but I don't really like it. Then, after food smells (someti

fetch.name: Fortune
fetch.bio: As Fortune approaches two years in foster care, everyone who knows him is asking the same question: How has this wonderful boy not been adopted yet? Fortune is a sweet, gentle Great Pyrenees mix who's simply looking for a patient family willing to give him the time he needs to feel safe. Once he trusts you, you'll have one of the most loyal companions you could ask for. Fortune is truly an easy dog to live with. He's fully potty trained, dog-door trained, and non-destructive when left home alone. He settles into a routine beautifully and asks for very little—just a safe place, a little patience, and someone to love. One of Fortune's favorite activities is going for walks, and he's an absolute gentleman on a leash. He also loves car rides, making him the perfect road trip companion. At home, you'll often find him relaxing in the sunshine or happily patrolling the yard, always keeping an eye out for squirrels, rabbits, and other critters. When he feels safe, he loves to run and explore, so a securely fenced yard is required. Fortune enjoys being brushed, does well during baths, and settles nicely in his kennel. With his low-to-medium energy level, he's just as happy lounging around the house as he is exploring the backyard. Fortune is shy, especially around men, and needs adopters who understand that trust takes time. He'll thrive with a family that allows him to adjust at his own pace and celebrates the little victories along the way. Watching him gain confidence is incredibly rewa

fetch.name: Russell
fetch.bio: I’M FREE! After 10 months in a small cage, I’m finally out and learning what it means to be a puppy. WOOHOO!I’m Russell, and I’m ready to make up for lost time. I’m looking for an active, patient family with another dog to run and play with — bonus points for a fenced yard where I can really let loose. I’m doing great with house training, and I’m working on my leash manners and getting comfortable in my crate. Now that I’ve discovered toys (and, okay, also magazines ), I’m all about chewing, playing, and exploring everything I missed out on. I’ve got a lot of energy and I’m eager to learn — I just need you to help me burn it off with walks, runs, and plenty of stimulation. Think we could be a match? Apply for me — I’m Russell, and I can’t wait to meet you! You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Turbo
fetch.bio: Meet Turbo Say hello to Turbo, a sweet 8-year-old Plott Hound who is ready to find a family of her very own! Turbo is a loving/sometimes playful/gentle/goofy pup who loves - walks, snuggling on the couch under a blanket, or just hanging out wherever you are. She is happiest when she is outside just soaking up some sun or in your bed with you at night. Her foster mom says, Turbo has been great. We have been working on counter surfing and barking. She is house-trained/crate-trained and leash-trained, but we have been working on that too as she is a hound and she likes to pull, which is understandable as they were bred to hunt after all. She is not fond of car rides, but loves to go in the car. She would do great with dogs/kids. Not sure about cats. Like every dog, Turbo has her own unique personality and may need a little time, patience, and encouragement while settling into a new home. But once she feels comfortable, she’ll reward you with plenty of love and loyalty. If you’re looking for a bed partner/goofy/loving companion who will be your best friend, Turbo might just be the one! Interested in giving Turbo a forever home? Apply to adopt and come meet this wonderful pup! You can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Zoey
fetch.bio: Hi, I’m Zoey! My smile goes for a million miles — which is exactly how far I can run! Don’t worry, though, I won’t run away from you. After a hard day of play, all I want is to snuggle up with you, because I’ve earned it! I’m very active, but I’m just as content watching you go about your morning or afternoon routine while I entertain myself. I have learned to give you my best puppy dog eyes while you’re busy, though — just to make sure I get some extra attention! I even love hopping into my crate for a little rest all on my own. I’m still working on my manners when I get excited to say hi — I used to jump up a lot, but I’m learning that I get way more love by keeping all four paws on the ground! I am eager to please and eager for attention, in whatever form it comes. The birds, rabbits, and squirrels around here haven’t caught on yet — they just run and fly away instead of sticking around to chat. Don’t they know how to have a conversation?!My tongue isn’t just for panting — it’s also for giving you all the kisses you could ever want. I’ll wrap my paws around yours and keep you close… as long as there aren’t any socks or Crocs nearby to distract me. I swear, “I thought that was a toy!” comes out of my mouth (sort of) way too often. They taste great — you should try it sometime! (Kidding. Mostly.) I always go potty outside, where I like to take care of business — and I definitely mix business with pleasure. I love big dogs and little dogs alike, though the little ones have a hard t

fetch.name: Twinkle
fetch.bio: Meet Twinkle Twinkle is a sweet girl who is just beginning her journey of discovering what it's like to be a beloved family pet. She is learning that the world can be a safe and happy place filled with belly rubs, couches to lay on, and lots of love. Twinkle is making great progress with house and potty training and will thrive with a patient family willing to continue helping her learn. She is still coming out of her shell is a little shy at first, but every day she becomes a little more confident. One thing Twinkle knows for sure is that she loves other dogs! Her happiest moments are spent running, playing, and exploring outside. A secure fenced yard is her dream, and having another playful, confident dog in the home would help her continue to build confidence and show her the ropes. Twinkle currently lives with children and is doing well with them. Because she is still learning to trust and adjust to family life, she will need an understanding home that will let her settle in at her own pace. If you're looking for a gentle soul to nurture and watch blossom into the dog she was always meant to be, Twinkle may be the perfect addition to your family. With patience, love, and a canine companion by her side, this special girl is sure to shine. Twinkle's Ideal Home:Another friendly, playful dog (unknown on how she is with cats)A secure fenced yardA patient family willing to continue her training and socializationA loving home that understands she may need time to adjust and potty tr

fetch.name: Daisy
fetch.bio: Hi, we're Daisy and Bella. We have found ourselves being surrendered to rescue because our parents had to go to assisted living. We were very well cared for and loved! Therfore, we would LOVE a home together if possible. We do well with older children, and we even have cats at our foster home! We like to play with our foster siblings and LOVE walks. We'd love a home where we can cuddle or chill on the couch with you. No worries leaving us at home, Daisy will even give you her biggest smile when you return! You can apply for us at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Eufert
fetch.bio: Hello big world! It’s me Eufert. I’m an almost 7 year old mini poodle. Ain’t I cuuuuute?!?!I’m a little bit brave and a lot a bit shy. I warm up, but slowly. I really like asking for attention and pets from the people I know, but I’m still getting used to accepting the nice pets without dodging them!! It’s such a silly thing having these conflicting feelings!! Yes pets! No pets! Yes pets! No pets! Gah!!!! What do I choose!?!?Even though I’m a bit shy, I’m tolerant of being handled: bathing, brushing, ear cleaning, grooming, being picked up…. A lot. I am excellent at going potty outside! I still get a little nervous seeing and hearing new things out there. But this walkin' is fun and really helping me explore and learn. I’m getting into sniffin' things and leaving my peemails around for the other neighborhood dogs. Super fun!!! I should have another dog in my forever home to help me feel most comfortable and help me continue coming out of my shell. fetch.name: Bud
fetch.bio: **COURTESY POST**Hi, I’m Bud! I’m a 2-year-old American Akita mix, tipping the scales at 59 lbs of love. Life dealt me a rough hand when my last owner abandoned me, but some wonderful people took me in and gave me a fresh start. I’m getting settled in and I’m ready to find my forever home! A little about me: I’m neutered, up to date on my vaccines, and microchipped — my new humans took great care of me I LOVE playing catch and I’ll happily play with any toy you hand me I’m a total snuggle bug — I crave affection and just want to be near my people I do well with other dogs and love to play, though I’m still working on my manners around cats and cows (a fenced yard would help me stay out of trouble!) I’m currently learning leash manners with my harnessSince my current family is helping me heal, I’ll come to you with all my vet records, my microchip info, and even a Fi Mini GPS tracker, so you can always find me. I’m hoping to find my forever humans soon — the kind who’ll give me space to run, love to give, and patience while I learn the ropes. If you think we might be a match, please fill out an application today! Located in Hatley, Wisconsin. You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Bella
fetch.bio: Hi, we're Daisy and Bella. We have found ourselves being surrendered to rescue because our parents had to go to assisted living. We were very well cared for and loved! Therfore, we would LOVE a home together if possible. We do well with older children, and we even have cats at our foster home! We like to play with our foster siblings and LOVE walks. We'd love a home where we can cuddle or chill on the couch with you. No worries leaving us at home, Daisy will even give you her biggest smile when you return! You can apply for us at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Cookie
fetch.bio: Meet Cookie – Your Future Best Friend! Hi, I’m Cookie, and I’ve come such a long way since entering foster care! I’ve been working hard to learn all the things that make me the perfect companion—I’m fully potty trained, can do stairs like a pro, and have mastered the art of couch and bed snuggles. I absolutely adore my foster mom and hate being away from her, so I know I’ll form a strong bond with my forever family, too. I’m still learning to trust new people, and sometimes I clam up in unfamiliar situations—but I promise, if you believe in me like my foster mom does, I’ll show you my HUGE, dorky, lovable personality! I’m looking for a patient and understanding home that will continue helping me build confidence. In return, I’ll give you unconditional love, endless tail wags, and a lifetime of loyalty. Could you be the one to give me my happily ever after? Apply to adopt me today! You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Rowdy (fka Buddy)
fetch.bio: Hi, I’m Rowdy – The Snuggle King, Ice Cream Connoisseur, and Bone Bandit Extraordinaire

southwood.name: Adam *Diabetic, In Foster*
southwood.bio: Adam is a handsome senior gentleman that would love a forever home to relax, unwind, and receive lots of love and give it in return! Adam was brought to us as a stray, and we soon realized that Adam was dealing with unmanaged diabetes. Adam has responded to his insulin very well and is back on track, and is ready for a home that is willing to help him be healthy and happy! Adam needs to be on a low-carb diet (this is easy, and we can give you a list of good foods that ARE NOT expensive!) and he also needs to eat only twice a day, and receive his insulin 30 minutes after each meal. Because his diabetes went unmanaged for an unknown length of time before he arrived to us, he does walk a bit flat on his back legs. This has gotten better now that his diabetes is managed, but he may always walk a little funny. Adam uses the litter box just fine and has no issues! He is an older gentleman though, and may need some minor help with grooming and brushing. Adam is so, so sweet and has so much love to give - please consider letting him into your heart and he will love you back tenfold! Less

southwood.name: Vanilla Bean/Agatha

She adores getting some pets while in your company, maybe even a few kisses. *Has done well with a dog previously, unknown with cats and other animals - no young kids please!* Less

southwood.name: Coral

Less

southwood.name: Gomez

southwood.name: Barley *Renal Diet*
southwood.bio: Meet Barley! At 8 years old, she is a sweet, gentle, and loving cat who absolutely adores attention. Her favorite thing is being pet, and she will happily soak up all the love you’re willing to give. She has a calm, affectionate personality and would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loving adult cat. She does require a renal diet, which is a specially formulated food designed to support kidney health. Renal diets typically contain controlled levels of protein, phosphorus, and other nutrients to help reduce the workload on the kidneys and support overall kidney function. She’ll need to stay on this diet as part of her ongoing care, but otherwise, she’s ready to find a loving home where she can be spoiled with plenty of pets and affection. If you’re looking for a sweet, cuddly companion with lots of love to give, this lovely girl may be the perfect match for you! Less

marshfield.name: Sassy

I’m past the kitten chaos stage, which means I offer the best kind of companionship: steady, devoted, and full of quiet curiosity. I just want to be wherever you are, offering a warm lap and a lifetime of affection. If you have room in your heart to help an older gal heal and thrive, apply to visit me today! We would love to be adopted together, but if that's not meant to be, we will be wonderful companions for your kitty at home. marshfield.name: Floki
marshfield.bio: Hi, I'm Floki, and I'm about 5 months old! I'm gonna give it to you straight—I'm a shy guy. But underneath that quiet exterior, I am truly the sweetest, gentlest soul ever! I was recently placed in a room with other kitties and I love them! We wrestle and play and have a great time. But when humans walk into the room, I'll run and hide. taylor.bio: Meet Cinder — a lively and lovable female hound with plenty of energy to spare. Cinder is ready to bring joy, excitement, and lots of love to her forever home.
